name: jlink-mcp
description: MCP server for SEGGER J-Link debug probes — LLM-driven embedded debugging with RTT, GDB, HSS, and JCAP
author: shjqwert

scripts.build:node: npm run clean && npm run compile && npm run bundle
scripts.build:release: npm run build:hss && npm run test:hss-helper && npm run build:node
scripts.test: npm run clean && npm run compile && npm run test:unit && npm run test:surface && npm run test:guidance && npm run test:legacy-scan && npm run test:acceptance-schema
scripts.test:unit: node scripts/run-tests.mjs out/probe/backend.test.js out/probe/jlink.test.js out/gdb/gdb-client.test.js out/gdb/elf-resolver.test.js out/mcp/acceptance/evidence.test.js out/mcp/acceptance/software-runner.test.js out/mcp/acceptance/published-summary.test.js out/mcp/artifact/artifact-catalog.test.js out/mcp/artifact/hot-variables.test.js out/mcp/artifact/symbol-catalog.test.js out/mcp/hss/hss-typed-value.test.js out/mcp/hss-dll/hss-api-candidate.test.js out/mcp/jcap/analysis-v0.test.js out/mcp/jcap/jcap-v0.test.js out/mcp/jcap/jcap-v1.test.js out/mcp/preflight/temp-preflight.test.js out/mcp/rtt-channel/rtt-channel.test.js out/mcp/runtime/target-store.test.js out/mcp/runtime/probe-queue.test.js out/mcp/runtime/memory-session.test.js out/mcp/runtime/direct-operations.test.js out/mcp/runtime/artifact-operations.test.js out/mcp/runtime/file-lease.test.js out/mcp/runtime/hss-helper-adapter.test.js out/mcp/runtime/hss-operations.test.js out/mcp/runtime/svd-operations.test.js out/mcp/runtime/session-operations.test.js out/mcp/svd/svd-catalog.test.js out/mcp/sqlite-runtime.test.js out/utils/atomic-file.test.js
scripts.test:ci: npm run build:release && npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm run test:surface && npm run test:guidance && npm run test:legacy-scan && npm run test:package && npm run test:privacy
scripts.test:release: npm run test:ci && node scripts/test-doctor.mjs && npm run audit:runtime
scripts.test:hss-contract: npm run compile && node scripts/run-tests.mjs out/mcp/hss-dll/hss-api-candidate.test.js
scripts.test:jcap: npm run build:node && node --test out/mcp/sqlite-runtime.test.js out/mcp/jcap/jcap-v0.test.js out/mcp/jcap/jcap-v1.test.js
